actual_paragraph: An earlier Kallola-Junior screening in 2016 included *Aji Thu Ekathi*, made by students of St Xavier’s High School, Khandagiri. Aaina’s 2023–24 report also names *Nagabali Ra Abhiman*, made by students of Pitamahal Ashram School.[^kallola-student-films] What stories might children choose to tell about the places they know?
